description: This file defines data models for a book detail view in a reading app, including classes for 'BookDetail' and 'Chapter', with methods for JSON serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: BookDetail
classes.description: Encapsulates comprehensive information about a book, including metadata, chapters, and bookmarks.

classes.name: Chapter
classes.description: Represents a single chapter with its index, title, and content URL.

methods.name: BookDetail.fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a BookDetail instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: BookDetail.toJson
methods.description: Serializes a BookDetail instance into a JSON map.

methods.name: Chapter.fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a Chapter instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: Chapter.toJson
methods.description: Serializes a Chapter instance into a JSON map.
